sinopsis.es: Tras la desaparición de su madre durante la primera ventisca de la temporada, un joven se niega a perder la esperanza mientras un largo invierno de Montana rehace su relación con el padre y su idea del hombre en que se está convirtiendo. De Andrew Haigh, aclamado director de All of Us Strangers.
sinopsis.en: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Montana winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming. From Andrew Haigh, the acclaimed director of All of Us Strangers.
